mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is observed in historical data.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 3.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% indicates a weak labor market, which is associated with reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This threshold is based on historical evidence of labor market stress.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195.0) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals a 'sticky inflation' scenario, where the market anticipates delayed monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 195.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 3.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high-demand regime, defined by HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 340000, indicates strong consumer and housing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2000 AND RSAFS > 340000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO (above 118.0) indicates strong industrial output, which is associated with robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 118.0 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 195.0 indicates persistent inflation, which leads to delayed monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 195.0 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, defined by PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE < 5.0%, signals inflationary pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 130000 AND UNRATE < 5.0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 340000), strong consumer and housing activity supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2000 AND RSAFS > 340000 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.
